alum co-adjuvanted oil adjuvant haemorhagice septicaemia vaccine is more immunogenic and more stable compared to oil adujavant vaccine.
the alum precipitated oil emulsion vaccine is more stable, immunogenic and protective against haemorrhagic septiceamia in mice as compared to the standard oil adjuvanted vaccine.

the development of alum precipitated oil emulsion vaccine which may be a potential candidate for the control of haemorrhagic septicemia.
the development of a novel vaccine formulation for the control of haemorrhagic septiceamia in cattle.
the development of an effective vaccine against HS in mice.

the alum precipitated OAV has better stability, produces higher antibody titer and protection against HS in mice.
A-OAV is a better vaccine than the standard OAV for HS.
alum precipitated OAV (A-OAV) is more effective than OAV.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the addition of alum to OAV enhances emulsion stability and immunogenicity and provides better protection against HS.
the alum co-adjuvanted vaccine has better emulsion stability and produces better humoral and cell mediated immune responses against HS in mice model.
alum co-adjuvanted OAV is more potent than OAV alone.

A–OVA can be used as an alternative to OAV for the control of haemorrhagic septicemia.
the alum co-adjuvanted oil adjuvant emulsion is more stable and produces a better immune response compared to the oil adjuvant only emulsion.
the alum co-adjuvanted oil adjuvant is a potent and safe vaccine for the control of haemorhagice septicaemia.
